description: Returns the current user, company (the workspace, with its name; null for an unnamed workspace), plan facts, role catalog with permissions, connected messaging accounts, and the Knowledge Base in one response. The workspace is the one named by the workspace argument, or the account's only usable workspace when the argument is left out; one connection reaches every workspace of the account, each named per request. plan holds the workspace's plan facts on Cloud (null elsewhere): plan is the current plan id, onFreePlan whether it runs on the free plan, trialDaysLeft the days left in the free trial (null when not in a trial), lostOnFree what stops working on the free plan as { kind, count } entries, keepsItRunning the cheapest plan that keeps all of it running (null when nothing would be lost) and choosePlanUrl the absolute link to the workspace's billing settings where a plan is chosen. On the first page wiki.guide is the Operating Guide (nextOffset marks where the full page continues) and wiki.procedures lists procedures with whenToUse. wiki.items are knowledge pages, ten per page in creation order, each with id, title, url, timestamps and a short opening excerpt, not the complete page. wiki.nextPage is the wikiPage value of the following catalog page. wiki is omitted without Knowledge Base Read. A page's owner and verifiedAt (when someone last confirmed it is correct) appear when set. For someone who may edit pages, wiki.upkeep on the first page counts what is open, and is omitted when nothing is: openQuestions the Knowledge Base could not answer, orphanPages that no other page links to and pagesWithDeadLinks that link to a page that no longer exists; the two link counts are left out while links of recently changed pages are still being read. Each role carries its full permission list; without role management only the user's own role is listed, and a user's roleId matches a role id. Each connected account includes { id, provider, status, emailAddress, displayName, shared, isOwner, lastSyncedAt, linkedinProducts }; the id is the connectedAccountId of that account and status is its connection status. lastSyncedAt is the time the account's last history import finished, not the time of its newest message: a message that arrives later leaves it unchanged. For LinkedIn, linkedinProducts lists which products the account can send from (classic, sales_navigator, recruiter).

wikiPage.description: Knowledge Base catalog page, ten entries per page (default 1)

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: get_workspace_context
title: Get workspace context
